name: Auth0 Authentication
rationale: Auth0 integrations need clear server-owned session, token, and authorization boundaries so UI code does not handle secrets or trust decisions.

fileRules.name: Auth Server Boundary
fileRules.rule: UI files must not own token verification, session secrets, or authorization decisions.
fileRules.trigger: A UI file imports auth/session/token modules or reads auth secret environment variables.
fileRules.recommendation: Move Auth0 token/session work behind src/server/auth and pass safe user state to UI.
fileRules.goodExample: A server auth module verifies tokens and the UI receives a serialized user summary.
fileRules.badExample: A client component imports JWT/session helpers or reads AUTH0_SECRET.

detectors.description: Flags auth/session imports or auth secret env reads in UI files.

moduleBoundaries: Authentication and authorization checks belong in server-owned modules.
UI may consume safe user/session summaries but must not handle secrets.
testingExpectations: Add tests for protected-route decisions and denied access paths.
agentInstructions: Ask for confirmation before changing auth/session behavior or public authorization boundaries.
